hold_reason: Refund mismatch: Alpha Co's W2 reported refund of order 150 (amount_cents 12682) as applied, but list_refunds shows only refunds for orders 151 (15870) and 155 (4209). Order 150 belongs to customer acme (order amount 18740). Paying acme from net_balance may overpay if the refund is not on the ledger. Needs human review of whether the 150 refund was applied before payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: Start by checking the orders and refunds before paying anyone, since payouts can't be recalled.
